90001.name: Earthquake
90001.description: You experience natural disaster and parts of your body are permanently damaged.

90002.name: Airplane Crash
90002.description: You experience a severe accident, and you are dead.

90003.name: Farewell, Mom
90003.description: Your mom dies from an incurable rare disease. You experience a mental breakdown.

90004.name: Bankruptcy
90004.description: After being scammed out of a large sum of money, you fall seriously ill.

90005.name: Rape
90005.description: You are raped by a distant relative from your father’s side.

90006.name: Helen of Troy
90006.description: Almost overnight, you become drop-dead gorgeous and become the center of attention ever since.

90007.name: Job oppotunity
90007.description: You gain an opportunity to realize your personal value.

90008.name: You are beautiful
90008.description: You undergo a minimally invasive cosmetic procedure.

90009.name: A miracle of life
90009.description: You become a participant in the latest full-body medical scan, and during the examination, every ailment you have—whether major or minor—is cured all at once.

90010.name: Queen's gambit
90010.description: Your mom makes you take the new "Grow Happy" drug. It significantly boosts your intelligence.
